text: Anchor Stones brace the corners of a pattern. They do nothing else: no Pulse, no inventory, no upkeep.
A shape that has them reaches a tier higher than one that does not.

pages.title: Placing them
text: Set them where the Codex shows ghosts at the corners, then leave them be. They are not generators and need nothing from you.
Break one and the pattern drops a tier until you put it back.
- **Stone Font**: four, at the corners of a 5x5, for stone and obsidian.
- **Listening Pit**: four for the 5x5 pit, eight for Deep Listening.
- **Far Gate**: four, at the corners of its footprint.

pages.text: Four March Stone and an Echo Shard make **four**.
